name: GA-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Austin Scott running with large financial edge ($1.35M vs $1.7K)
No polls or expert ratings; market gives Dem ~7%
model.rationale: The baseline of R+16.6 rests on a solidly red district, an entrenched incumbent, and a massive fundraising disparity, with no evidence pointing the other way. Prediction markets and the absence of any contestable fundamentals justify holding near Safe R.
model.watch: A surprise scandal, redistricting change, or late outside spending against Scott could narrow the race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Georgia's 8th District is a strongly Republican seat, with a partisan lean of about fifteen points toward the GOP. Austin Scott, the incumbent, is running for reelection after easily securing his party's nomination, and he holds a commanding financial advantage: roughly $1.35 million on hand against about $1,700 for Democratic challenger Kelly Esti, who has raised under $20,000.

There are no public polls or expert ratings for this race, and no outside spending of consequence. Prediction markets give the Democrat only about a seven percent chance of winning. With the fundamentals, money, and incumbency all aligned, this race is rated Safe Republican, with an expected margin near seventeen points.
